messages:
zoe_cs: Heads-up — new inbound from customer (PlutoPay) asking to onboard a bilingual (en/es) reranker for their payments search. They need PHI-scoping (they surface masked cardholder names in some flows), want customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS), and prefer a private deployment behind their VPC. They're evaluating renewal timing with current vendor so this is high-impact for retention.
ana_onboarding: thanks Zoe. Do we have target qps / latency SLOs and preferred model size? can they accept a quantized variant?
zoe_cs: Customer said p95 < 150ms for reranking path, peak 80 qps, baseline 10 qps. They suggested a 13B family model but open to 7B if latency wins. Quantization ok if we validate accuracy drop.
mike_eng: @ana_onboarding I can run a quick model-compat check. Do they need on-prem HSM (air-gapped) or cloud KMS in their VPC?
zoe_cs: prefer cloud KMS in their VPC first, might push to on-prem HSM later for compliance. Also asked for evals: accuracy on bilingual relevance, PHI leakage test, latency under load.
kelly_se: I'll prepare an eval checklist and a small prompt set from their sample queries. Zoe — can you share 200 anonymized queries? we need positive/negative labels if possible.
zoe_cs: uploading a CSV link to their sample queries now (sent privately).
deploy-bot: ticket created: CS-7843 — PlutoPay bilingual reranker intake. Assigned to: ana_onboarding, mike_eng. ETA for triage: 2 business days.
ana_onboarding: triage notes: candidate infra paths: Dedicated w/ private VPC routing OR Redwood Private (customer-managed control plane). For HSM we can support KMS integration with their AWS account (cross-account IAM). Need legal/security sign-off for PHI handling.
mike_eng: quick notes: recommended model variants to test: rwr-13b-rlhf (float16), rwr-13b-quant-4bit, rwr-7b-qlora. Will run two benchmarks: 1) offline rerank quality (MRR/Recall@10) on their labeled set; 2) load test for p95 at 80 qps with auto-batching settings.
kelly_se: renewal angle — customer flagged previous vendor as slow on SLA and poor rollout support. If we can commit to a canary rollout + playbook for rollback and a 90-day adoption check-in, that helps retention. I'll draft a renewal risk mitigation note.
ana_onboarding: blockers: need anonymized dataset + their KMS ARN + compliance contact. Also ask security for PHI classification guidance. cc @mike_eng for model tests.
zoe_cs: pinged customer for dataset + KMS ARN, they replied aiming to share by EOD tomorrow. Also gave compliance contact: maria.g@plutopay.com.
mike_eng: starting compatibility tests tomorrow. I'll post raw perf numbers and a small repro script. snippet of load command I'll use:
```
./load-test --model rwr-13b-quant-4bit --qps 80 --concurrency 32 --seq 128 --metrics p95,p50
```
kelly_se: draft enablement plan: 1) onboarding kick (week 0), 2) private deployment + KMS config (week 1-2), 3) canary traffic (week 3), 4) rollout + adoption check (week 6-12). I'll attach to the CS ticket.
deploy-bot: reminder: compliance review required for PHI-handling. Add tag: PHI-REVIEW.
ana_onboarding: next steps for us: - collect dataset/KMS ARN - security & legal outreach - run model candidate evals - propose infra (Dedicated vs Private) w/ cost estimate. I'll own scheduling the security review.
zoe_cs: thanks all — I'll keep customer updated and post dataset link when received. :thumbsup:
kelly_se: noted. If anyone wants to pair on the canary playbook let me know. :wave:
